pre_condition: extracted_base is the root directory of extracted functions. src_rel is a non-empty string identifying a source file by its path relative to the project root, following phases.json directory conventions.
post_condition: Returns a directory path under extracted_base where extracted function files for the source file identified by src_rel are placed. The path is formed by joining extracted_base with the directory components of src_rel, then appending a directory name derived from the basename of src_rel: when the basename contains a '.' after the first character, the directory name replaces that last '.' with '-'; otherwise the directory name is the basename unchanged. The returned string preserves the directory hierarchy of src_rel relative to the project root.
